_comment: List of dataset folder names (without 'lerobot_datasets-' prefix) to convert from v1 → v2. v2 output is named '<v1_name><v2_suffix>'. All paths are resolved relative to <REPO_ROOT>/datasets/<name>. Optional 'cameras' is a length-4 array of 0/1, ordered [left_eye, right_eye, left_wrist, right_wrist]; 0 = drop that camera from the v2 output (videos/, meta/info.json features entry, meta/stats.json top-level key, and the 4 videos/<cam>/* columns in meta/episodes/chunk-000/*.parquet). Missing 'cameras' key = all cameras enabled (backward compatible).
